names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Ιννοκέντιος ο Θαυματουργός», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Ιννοκέντιος κοιμήθηκε στις 19 Μαρτίου του 1521 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 1521)». It adds that a carved stone on his grave gives the year, the month and the day of his repose.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). The Greek page makes him a Muscovite and a Russian abbot, so a Russian row is likely and has not been read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ιννοκέντιος ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page heads him «(; - 1521)», names his family the Okhlyabinin in Latin letters, and cites OCA's Feasts and Saints. Its epithet for him is ο Θαυματουργός, the Wonderworker; the English form chosen here takes instead the river the page says his monastery stood on, because the rank belongs in the types.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
